mapper.select: SELECT b.board_seq AS boardSeq, b.user_seq AS userSeq, u.user_name AS userName, b.category, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, b.view_count AS viewCount, b.board_writedate AS boardWritedate, b.board_update AS boardUpdate FROM board b JOIN user u ON b.user_seq = u.user_seq ORDER BY b.board_writedate DESC
